Class SerialConnection

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.connection.SerialConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
FrameFormatAwareConnection, MeshtasticConnection, TransportConnection
public class SerialConnection extends Object implements MeshtasticConnection, FrameFormatAwareConnection
Serial connection to a Meshtastic device over USB or Bluetooth SPP.

Uses JNA wrappers (NativeSerialPort) for direct port access through kernel32 on Windows or libc/termios on macOS and Linux. Unlike jSerialComm, the port can be opened without asserting DTR, preventing ESP32 resets on USB-Serial bridges such as CH340 and CP210x. jSerialComm remains limited to discovery and adapter identification.
